prompt:
Write an AIC function 'is_even' that returns 1 if n is even, and 0 if odd.
Signature: [: is_even [n] [D ...]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_even 0] 1 "0 is even"]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_even 2] 1 "2 is even"]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_even 7] 0 "7 is odd"]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_even -4] 1 "-4 is even"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'sum_to_n' that computes the sum of integers from 1 to n (1 + 2 + ... + n). If n <= 0, return 0.
Signature: [: sum_to_n [n] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: sum_to_n [n] [D
  [? [<= n 0] [^ 0] [D]]
  [! total 0]
  [@> 1 [+ n 1] [i] [D
    [! total [+ total i]]
  ]]
  [^ total]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[test_assert_eq runner [sum_to_n 0] 0 "sum(0) == 0"]
[test_assert_eq runner [sum_to_n 5] 15 "sum(5) == 15"]
[test_assert_eq runner [sum_to_n 10] 55 "sum(10) == 55"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'int_power' that computes base^exp for non-negative exp.
Signature: [: int_power [base exp] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: int_power [base exp] [D
  [! res 1]
  [! b base]
  [! e exp]
  [W [> e 0] [D
    [? [!= [& e 1] 0] [! res [* res b]] [D]]
    [! b [* b b]]
    [! e [>> e 1]]
  ]]
  [^ res]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[test_assert_eq runner [int_power 2 0] 1 "2^0 == 1"]
[test_assert_eq runner [int_power 2 10] 1024 "2^10 == 1024"]
[test_assert_eq runner [int_power 3 4] 81 "3^4 == 81"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'count_digits' that returns the number of digits in positive integer n (in base 10).
Signature: [: count_digits [n] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: count_digits [n] [D
  [? [== n 0] [^ 1] [D]]
  [! count 0]
  [! x n]
  [W [> x 0] [D
    [! x [/ x 10]]
    [! count [+ count 1]]
  ]]
  [^ count]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_digits 7] 1 "digits(7) == 1"]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_digits 42] 2 "digits(42) == 2"]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_digits 12345] 5 "digits(12345) == 5"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'word_array_sum' that computes the sum of elements in a 64-bit word buffer.
Signature: [: word_array_sum [[$ buf] len] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: word_array_sum [[$ buf] len] [D
  [! total 0]
  [@> len [i] [D
    [! total [+ total [@@ buf i]]]
  ]]
  [^ total]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[! arr [H [* 4 8]]]
[@@! arr 0 10]
[@@! arr 1 20]
[@@! arr 2 30]
[@@! arr 3 40]
[test_assert_eq runner [word_array_sum arr 4] 100 "sum of 10..40 is 100"]
[test_assert_eq runner [word_array_sum arr 0] 0 "sum of empty is 0"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'word_array_max' that finds the maximum element in a non-empty word buffer.
Signature: [: word_array_max [[$ buf] len] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: word_array_max [[$ buf] len] [D
  [! m [@@ buf 0]]
  [@> 1 len [i] [D
    [! v [@@ buf i]]
    [? [> v m] [! m v] [D]]
  ]]
  [^ m]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[! arr [H [* 5 8]]]
[@@! arr 0 15]
[@@! arr 1 42]
[@@! arr 2 9]
[@@! arr 3 88]
[@@! arr 4 33]
[test_assert_eq runner [word_array_max arr 5] 88 "max is 88"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'count_occurrences' counting how many times val appears in word buffer buf.
Signature: [: count_occurrences [[$ buf] len val] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: count_occurrences [[$ buf] len val] [D
  [! c 0]
  [@> len [i] [D
    [? [== [@@ buf i] val] [! c [+ c 1]] [D]]
  ]]
  [^ c]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[! arr [H [* 5 8]]]
[@@! arr 0 7]
[@@! arr 1 2]
[@@! arr 2 7]
[@@! arr 3 7]
[@@! arr 4 5]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_occurrences arr 5 7] 3 "7 appears 3 times"]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_occurrences arr 5 2] 1 "2 appears 1 time"]
[test_assert_eq runner [count_occurrences arr 5 99] 0 "99 appears 0 times"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'is_sorted_asc' checking if a word buffer is sorted in non-decreasing order.
Signature: [: is_sorted_asc [[$ buf] len] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: is_sorted_asc [[$ buf] len] [D
  [? [<= len 1] [^ 1] [D]]
  [! sorted 1]
  [@> [- len 1] [i] [D
    [? [> [@@ buf i] [@@ buf [+ i 1]]] [! sorted 0] [D]]
  ]]
  [^ sorted]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[! arr1 [H [* 3 8]]]
[@@! arr1 0 10] [@@! arr1 1 20] [@@! arr1 2 30]
[! arr2 [H [* 3 8]]]
[@@! arr2 0 10] [@@! arr2 1 5] [@@! arr2 2 30]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_sorted_asc arr1 3] 1 "arr1 is sorted"]
[test_assert_eq runner [is_sorted_asc arr2 3] 0 "arr2 is not sorted"]
[test_summary runner]

prompt:

Signature: [: count_set_bits [n] [D ...]]

[: count_set_bits [n] [D

prompt:
Write an AIC function 'linear_search' finding first index of target in word buffer buf, or -1 if not found.
Signature: [: linear_search [[$ buf] len target] [D ...]]
canonical_solution:
[: linear_search [[$ buf] len target] [D
  [! res -1]
  [! i 0]
  [W [&& [== res -1] [< i len]] [D
    [? [== [@@ buf i] target] [! res i] [D]]
    [! i [+ i 1]]
  ]]
  [^ res]
]]
test:
[! runner [test_runner_init]]
[! arr [H [* 4 8]]]
[@@! arr 0 42] [@@! arr 1 17] [@@! arr 2 99] [@@! arr 3 8]
[test_assert_eq runner [linear_search arr 4 99] 2 "99 at index 2"]
[test_assert_eq runner [linear_search arr 4 42] 0 "42 at index 0"]
[test_assert_eq runner [linear_search arr 4 100] -1 "100 not found"]
[test_summary runner]
